subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word:

EFFRONTERY
solution:
The correct answer is: **Audacity**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Effrontery"** means shameless boldness or impudence; behavior that is shockingly rude or disrespectful. (ढिठाई, बेहयाई)
 
 
 
• **Example:** The student's effrontery in questioning the teacher's authority shocked the entire class.
 
 
 
• **"Audacity"** means boldness or daring, especially with confident disregard for personal safety or conventional thought; it can also imply shameless or brazen behavior. (साहस, ढिठाई)
 
 
 
• **Example:** He had the audacity to criticize the manager during the meeting.
 
 
 
• Hence, the synonym of **"Effrontery"** is **"Audacity"**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Audacity**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Politeness** (शिष्टता): Behavior that is respectful and considerate of others.
 
 
 
• **Example:** His politeness and good manners impressed everyone at the dinner party.
 
 
 
• **Shyness** (संकोच): The quality of being reserved or nervous in the company of others.
 
 
 
• **Example:** Her shyness made it difficult for her to speak up in meetings.
 
 
 
• **Courtesy** (विनम्रता): Polite behavior or respect shown toward others.
 
 
 
• **Example:** He held the door open for her as a courtesy.
